Name: Willy is Furry Orca
Author: YYPch
Description:
This mod replaces Willy with a furry version.
It includes custom sprites and portraits.


[b]This mod includes a casual outfit featuring a leather jacket and a formal winter outfit, both ready to use.
For the casual look, there are two variations:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Option A:[/b] Nothing.[/*]
[*][b]Option B:[/b] Grey sleeveless undershirt.

[/*]
[/list]I have included both Option A and Option B files in the MyScaleerPack/assets (folder)
If you wish to switch between them, simply rename your preferred file to
Willy.png (for casual)  OR Willy_Winter.png (for winter)



[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

This mod is built based on the '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46026]Scaleer fork[/url]'.
If you already have '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46026]Scaleer fork[/url]' installed,
simply move this file into your Mods folder and you're good to go.
